text.body: || śrīḥ || || śrīśaṃ vandāmahe || ||śrīmadānandatīrthahṛdambaravāsiśrīvedavyāsāya namaḥ || śrīkavikulatilakaśrīmat‌trivikramapaṇḍitācāryasuta nārāyaṇapaṇḍitācāryakṛtā || śrīyogadīpikā || viṣṇuṃ śrīvallabhaṃ natvā madhvaṃ ca prāṇanāyakam‌ | gurūṃstrivikramāryaṃśca kriyate yogadīpikā || 1 || vihitaiḥ karmabhiḥ puṃso niṣiddhāni nakurvataḥ | paramārādhanaṃ bhak‍yā yogaḥ karmasu kauśalam‌ || 2 || mayi sthito madaṅgeṣu svatantro vyāptavān‌ hariḥ | sa sarvasyā'tmatantro māṃ svecchayā''vartayatyajaḥ || 3 || svātmanastasya pūjāḥ syurmanovākkāyavṛttayaḥ | mamaitā iti kartāramuddeś‍ṃ ca hariṃ smaret‌ || 4 || pūrṇaprasādakṛdviṣṇoryogo'yaṃ bandhamokṣadaḥ | kimu sāṅ‌khyamayaścetsa suprayukto'dhikāriṇā || 5 || yogyaṃ bhāgavataṃ gātaṃ jātakarmādikarmabhiḥ | haripūjātmake smārte svaputraṃ yojayetpitā || 6 || taṃ bālya eva pitrādyāḥ śikṣayeyurharipriyāḥ | yathāśakti yathāyogaṃ bhaktidharmavratādikarma || 7 || dvijo gurvarcakaḥ śuddhacaraṇo nityakarmakṛt‌ | sāyaṃprātaḥ samiddhomī bhaikṣānnādaḥ śrutīḥ paṭhet‌ || 8 || śrīmadbhāratatātparyanirṇayādyaṃ samabhyaset‌ | anadhyāye na tatkuryād‌vyutpanno nyāyaśikṣaṇam‌ || 9 || ujjhenniṣiddhakarmāṇi vihitāni samācaret‌ | bhajennṛsiṃhakṛṣṇādyaṃ jñānavighnapraśāntaye || 10 || anādibhaktiḥ parame dvijanmabhāk‌ apātakaḥ śabdanayānuśikṣaṇaḥ | adhītavedaḥ sutapā vratī gurorlabheta vidyāṃ paramāṃ prasannataḥ || 11 || sūtrabhāṣyādikaṃ śrutvā manvīta sakhibhiḥ saha | saṭīkamapyanadhyāye gītāprakaraṇādikam‌ || 12 || saṃskāravantamācāryo dīkṣayettaṃ haripriyam‌ | dīkṣayiṣyannamuṃ snātamācāntaṃ praṇataṃ paraḥ || 13 || pādodakaṃ ""tadasye ti prāśayetparameśituḥ | dīkṣitaḥ sa gurūddiṣṭairvratairupavaseddinam‌ || 14 || trīṇi vā pañcagavyāśī sapta pañca daśāpi vā | śucau same dṛḍhe deśe guruścakrābjamālikhet‌ || 15 || sa sannidhānavṛd‌dhyarthaṃ kalaśasnāpanādikam‌ | kuryāddharestathotpāteṣvapi dṛṣṭeṣu sarvathā || 16 || asavye puratastasya śucau deśe'mbujaṃ likhet‌ | tanmadhye pūrayecchālīṃsteṣu darbhānprasārayet‌ || 17 || kūrcaṃ tatrākṣatairyuktaṃ ""viṣṇurme prīyatā miti | gomayādbhirbahirliptvā'la'uryātkusumākṣataiḥ || 18 || ghaṭaṃ prakṣālya sūtreṇa trivṛtā veṣṭayedatha | dhūpāyedbahirantaśca padme'nyatsādayetpunaḥ || 19 || darbhairdvādaśabhiḥ kūrcaṃ navabhistribhireva vā | harermūrtyātmakaṃ smṛtvā badhvā tasyopari kṣipet‌ || 20 || atha mantrī kṛtasnānaḥ svācāntaḥ śuddhadehavān‌ | kṛtvā''tmadīpavighnārcāṃ kalaśārcanamācaret‌ || 21 || pūrvaṃ pīṭhārcanaṃ kṛtvā ghaṭamuttānayedbudhaḥ | candanākṣatapuṣpāṇi tasmin‌ svarṇaphale kṣipet‌ || 22 || ahanyupāhatāsvapsu vastrapūtāsu mūrtipaiḥ | harimāvāhaye "" dyāsā mṛcā mūlena vāruṇam‌ || 23 || kṛtvā ghaṭāsye kūrcāgraṃ tatrā'tmānaṃ prasecayet‌ | japaṃstu mūlamantrādīn‌ lipīśca prātilomyataḥ || 24 || tārānaṣṭāvaṣṭagandhairjalamūlena kampayet‌ | uśīraṃ ku'umaṃ māṃsī kuṣṭhaṃ malayajo'garuḥ || 25 || hīraberaṃ muraṃ ceti gandhāṣṭakamudīritam‌ | asaulabhye ca gandhānāṃ candanaṃ ca praśasyate || 26 || kṛtvodagraṃ tatra kūrcaṃ mūlenā'vāhayeddharim‌ | satkarāñjalinā dhūpaṃ gandhapuṣpākṣatāṃstathā || 27 || śaktiṃ sā'rṣaṇīṃ tasmin‌ kṛtvā mūlaṃ japettriśaḥ | tārānte ""bhagava nnuk‍vā tathā""''gacchetyanantaram‌ || 28 || ""āvāhayāmī ti cok‍vā mūlaṃ ca trirjapetpunaḥ | caturdaśa ca bījāni punarmūlamudāharet‌ || 29 || evamādityagādviṣṇordīpāddīpāntaraṃ yathā | vyūḍhamañjalinā rūpamānīyāvāhayejjale || 30 || mūlena mudrayetpīṭhamaṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ kaniṣṭhayoḥ | mūle sammuṭṛra mūlaṃ ca svāgataṃ cāpyudīrayet‌ || 31 || athānāmikayoḥ kṛtvā ""sthiro bhava samīrayet‌ | muṣṭīkṛtya tato'ṅguṣṭhe ""sanniruddo bhaveti ca || 32 || mūlena bindumudrābhyāṃ brūyāt‌ ""sannihito bhava | muṣṭīkṛtya tato'ṅguṣṭhau saṃhatau tu parasparam‌ || 33 || sakṛdāvṛtya mūlena brūyāt‌ ""saṃsthāpito bhava | evaṃ sambhāvya mudrābhirvyāpakanyāsamācaret‌ || 34 || triśastālena mūlādīn‌ mūlāṅgani nyasettataḥ | evamāvahya lipyaṅganyāsau kṛtvā lipīrnyaset‌ || 35 || satāraṃ vā'pi sājādyaṃ pratilomaṃ kalāśatam‌ | tatvāṅgāni tu tatvāni sthityutpattilayātmanā || 36 || mūlamantrākṣarāṅgāni nyasedṛṣyādikaṃ harau | cakraśa'gadāpadmamālāśrīvatsakaustubhān‌ || 37 || kirīṭaṃ kuṇḍale yoniṃ mṛdrayecchībhuvośca tān‌ | atha candrabhuvorbījaṃ japtvā baddhāñjalirnataḥ || 38 || kṣamāpaye""tkṣamasveti ""prasīdeti prasādayet‌ | panasāśvatthacūtānāṃ pallavānkalaśe kṣipet‌ || 39 || caṣake hemni tāmre vā taṇḍulānpallavopari | nikṣipya saphalaṃ tasminghaṭaṃ vastreṇa gūhayet‌ || 40 || sahasraṃ paramaṃ mūlaṃ japed‌dhyātvā śriyaḥ patim‌ | snapanīyānurūpeṇa pāvayantaṃ svatejasā || 41 || arghyādipañcakaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ ṣaḍ‌bhirjalādibhiḥ | sampūrṇakalaśaṃ prītyā pūjayā tūpasaṃharet‌ || 42 || kalaśāṅgatayā hutvā sampātaṃ tatra pūjayet‌ | tato'ṅga tatra vinyasya cakrādīnapi mudrayet‌ || 43 || tatastrirastramantreṇa arimudrāṃ pradarśayet‌ | atha cakrāmbuje viṣṇuṃ tacchak‍yupacitairdhanaiḥ || 44 || pūjayetparamaṃ tatra kuryurhomāṃśca mūrtipāḥ | tato dīkṣitamātmānaṃ prokṣettīrthāmbunā guruḥ || 45 || tālatrayādikaṃ kuryāttasya mūrdhani saṃspṛśet‌ | tadantaḥ pavanaṃ smṛtvā tadantaḥ paramaṃ smaret‌ || 46 || kṣetrajñaṃ bodhayettāraprāṇāyāmaistribhiḥ svayam‌ | prāṇāyāmaiḥ khagaiḥ pañcadīrghājāntairvilāpeyat‌ || 47 || kṣmādyaistaddehabhūtāni smṛtvā brahmaśarīriṇam‌ | tadgataṃ pāpakarmāṇaṃ parītaṃ pāpināṃ śataiḥ || 48 || nānākarmendriyādhārairvāyvāyāmena śoṣayet‌ | agninā''yamya vāyūṃstānnirdahetpuṃṛgātmanā || 49 || vāruṇena śiraścandrātpāvayedgalitāmṛtaiḥ | amṛtātmani majjantaṃ majjāyāṃ parameśvaraḥ || 50 || sadruṇairjñānabhaktayādyairviśiṣyotpādayediti | smaraṃstāraṃ japetpañcaviṃśadvāraṃ sameśituḥ || 51 || tatvarūpāṇi saṃsmṛtya sṛṣṭidvāreṇa śaktimān‌ | atha brāhmaśarīrasthaṃ dīpojjvalitacitprabham‌ || 52 || pīyūṣabudbadākāraṃ tatvadevopabṛṃhitam‌ | khādidvāreṇa sṛjati paramātmeti cintayet‌ || 43 || prāṇāyāmānpañca kuryāduditānprātilomyataḥ | atha sarvāṅgasampannamamṛtastrāviṇaṃ hareḥ || 54 || bhaktijñānādipūrṇaṃ taṃ sattamaṃ saṃsmaredrurum‌ | nyasellipyādikaṃ sarvaṃ hariṃ dhyātvā samāhitaḥ || 55 || praṇataḥ samanujñāto hariṇā guruṇā ca saḥ | kūrcapāṇiḥ śanairgacchedaiśānyāṃ snānamaṇṭapam‌ || 56 || dṛṣṭ‌vā''dityaṃ hariṃ smṛtvopaviśetsvastikāntare | kuśavrīhyakṣataiḥ siddha āsane tūrdhvajānukaḥ || 57 || ācāryo jalagandhādyaiḥ kalaśaṃ pūjayettataḥ | prasthānārghyaṃ pradāyāṅgaṃ nyasyainaṃ proddharecchanaiḥ || 58 || nayetpradakṣiṇāvartamātapatropaśobhitam‌ | āryo vādyaviśeṣeṇa kalaśaṃ tamupānayet‌ || 49 || maulāvakṣatamādāya dhūpayetpallavipluṣaḥ | vinyasya kūrcaṃ snāpayetprāñjaliḥ kalaśodakaiḥ || 60 || mūlamātraṃ japeddhīmānanulomaṃ tathā lipīḥ | puṃsūktaṃ ca smaredetadrūpaṃ tasminsamāhitaḥ || 61 || punaraṅgāni vinyasya hṛdayaṃ tatra saṃspṛśet‌ | paridhāya navaṃ vāso dhautaṃ vā''cānta ānataḥ || 62 || dhṛtordhvapuṇḍo maunī sa maṇḍape praṇameddharim‌ | ācāryo dakṣiṇe pārśve nataṃ tamupaveśayet‌ || 63 || saparyāhomasampātenājyenainaṃ samañjayet‌ | lipyādikaṃ punarnyasya taṃ spṛṣṭ‌vā prajapenmanum‌ || 64 || hṛdaye tasya yogena śrīpatiṃ pratidīpayet‌ | haripriyairanujñātamapohya janatāṃ tataḥ || 65 || vedāñjalisphuratkūrcamūrdhvajānumupāsitam‌ | śrāvayetparamaṃ tatvaṃ mūlamantrānapītarān‌ || 66 || tricatuḥpañcavāraṃ vā yathāyogyaṃ yathāvidhi | gururvedamayaṃ hastaṃ tasya mūrdhani vinyaset‌ || 67 || bhaktijñānādikaṃ dadyādvāraṃ samprītaye hareḥ | ācāryamarcayetso'tha dakṣiṇābhiḥ samūrtipaḥ || 68 || viṣṇorniveditānnena bhojayedvaiṣṇavaṃ janam‌ | sa pūjāmupasaṃhṛtya prārthayetparameśvaram‌ || 69 || karmasiddhiṃ hi śiṣyasya sa hi sarvaphalapradaḥ | śanakaiḥ śrṛṇuyāttantrasārasaṅ‌grahamādarāt‌ || 70 || anutiṣṭhecca tantroktaṃ śāstraṃ vijñānadīpanam‌ | tatroditāñjapenmantrāṃstaddevadhyānamācaret‌ || 71 || mantrasiddhasya tasyā'śu paramātmā prasīdati | īdṛśaḥ puruṣo yogamarhatyeva viśeṣataḥ || 72 || tatvadaivānyanugrāhya sa sukhī yogamācaret‌ || 73 || iti yogadīpikāyāṃ prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ | dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ | ācariṣyanpumānyogaṃ svasya dehendriyādiṣu | bhāvayetsaccidānandaṃ harerdehendriyādikam‌ || 1 || atha bhāvaṃ samastaṃ vā kurvāṇo yogayeddharau | mayi sthitaḥ karotīśaḥ kuryāṃ tatprītaye tviti || 2 || parivrajedvā so'dhyāyī varṇyeva paramādguroḥ | ato'nyathā guruḥ prājñastaṃ samāvartayīta vā || 3 || śuśrūṣādakṣiṇātṛptadgurorlabdhavaraḥ sudhīḥ | sāṅ‌khyayogasudhāndhiuḥ saṃśrayedāśramāntaram‌ || 4 || svāśramocitayā vṛttyā bhagavantaṃ samarcayet‌ | anyatparityajetrityaṃ kiṃ tenānarthakāriṇā || 5 || ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryāparigrahī | śucistapasvī santuṣṭāḥ svādhyāyābhyarcanavratī || 6 || sacchāstraṃ śrṛṇuyātpṛṣṭ‌vā bahuvīryaḥ punaḥ punaḥ | manvīta sakhibhiryāvatsarvathā śāsranirṇayam‌ || 7 || padmādyaṃ pavanāyāmairūpasaṃhṛtakilbiṣaḥ | hariṃ dhyāyanparaṃ śāsramavamarśetpunaḥ || 8|| prabūyādapi śiṣyebhya ityupāstisamagratā | satsūttameṣu bhaktaḥ syātsnigdhaḥ satsvadhameṣu ca || 9|| haribhakteṣu no kuryādasūyākopamatsarān‌ | śrīmadānandatīrthapādareṇuniṣeviṣu || 10 || kuryādbhaktiṃ manoramyāmamī hi bhavabheṣajam‌ | kiṃ punastatdeveṣu śrīmadhvānādiseviṣu || 11 || vāṇyāṃ ca vedavidyāyāṃ śrīmadhve kā kathā punaḥ | ""yasya deve parā bhaktiryathā deve tathā gurau || 12|| tasya pūrṇasukhānyāha śrutireṣā sanātanī | muhūrte brāhya utthāya sarvātmānaṃ hariṃ hṛdi || 13 || smṛtvā'to nirgato'nena jagarmītyanucintayet‌ | svāmindāso'smi te nityaṃ priyaṃ te kiṃ karomyaham‌ || 14 || apriye bhavato nātha māgānme manaādikam‌ | ityabhyarthya ramānathaṃ sa kuryātsatataṃ kriyāḥ || 15 || śarīraṃ śoghayetpūrvaṃ devasannidhisiddhaye | gatvā tu nairṛtīmāśāṃ gavāderapurobhuvi || 16 || vinyasya tṛṇamekānte tatra mūtraṃ pravartayet‌ | udaṅ‌mukhoṃ'śukaśirā rātrau ceddakṣiṇāmukhaḥ || 17 || śuṣkayā dṛḍhayā yaṣṭ‌yā vāmadoṣṇā ca recayet‌ | liṅgāgraṃ vāmahastena saṅgahaṇaṃstata utthitaḥ || 18 || avilok‍ samāyāto mṛtsnayā śaucamādaret‌ | gandhalepāpakarṣārthaṃ sakṛlliṅge triśaḥ kare || 19 || mṛd‌grāhyā saptaśo'pāne pāṇyorliṅge triśastriśaḥ | kuryāduktaṃ tataḥ śaucaṃ sakṛlliṅge mṛdā triśaḥ || 20 || savye ca pañcaśo'pāne daśakṛtvaśca savyake | saptakṛtvo dvayoḥ pāṇyorliṅge vyaktaṃ punastriśaḥ || 21 || prakṣālya sak‍ideśaṃ ca paridadhyādathāṃśukam‌ | prakṣālya trirmudā pādau gaṇḍūṣāndvādaśā'caret‌ || 22 || ācāntaḥ śaucamṛccheṣaṃ tyak‍vā tatkṣālayetsthalam‌ | prakṣālya jānupaddhastān‌ mukhaṃ ca salilaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 23 || ācamyārghyādibhirbhūyo'pyācamyā'cānta ucyate | jalādyugavidūre tu prāṅ‌mukho munirāsitaḥ || 24 || dantānviśodhya tatsthānaṃ jalamānīya siñcayet‌ | kaṇṭakāḥ kṣīriṇaḥ kāṣṭhāḥ prādeśottaramānakāḥ || 25 || praśastāssinduvārādyā niṣiddhā dantadhāvane | abhāve dantakāṣṭhānāṃ niṣiddhe vā tathā'hani || 26 || apāṃ dvādaśagaṇḍūṣaiḥ parṇairvā dantaśodhanam‌ | dantānviśodhya gaṇḍūṣaiḥ śodhayitvā tato mukham‌ || 27 || ācānto mṛttikāṃ tīrthātpāṇibhyāmapavāhayet‌ | ""pañcapiṇḍānanuddhatya na snāyātparavāriṣu || 28 || iti smṛtivacomānātsnānaparyāptisiddhaye | ""uddhrate ti mṛdā limpeddehe kakṣālikeṣvatha || 29 || asaṃjānurupṛṣṭheṣu nametkṛṣṇaramāgurūn‌ | tīrthānyāvāhaye ""ccema mṛcā''nābhi jale sthitaḥ || 30 || apavāhayecca salilaṃ ""yadapā miti mantrataḥ | tatra majjeddhariṃ dhyātvā dviṣaḍaṣṭaṣaḍakṣarān‌ || 31 || mantrāṃśca manasā japtvā tatpādasparśanaṃ smaret‌ | ""āgacchantviti mantreṇa jalaṃ trirapasavyataḥ || 32 || pitṛbhyaḥ prakṣipe ""dviṣṇuḥ prīyatāmiti cintayet‌ | unmṛjyāṅgāni cā'cānta āpyamantraiḥ samukṣatāt‌ || 33 || pūrvāvanmṛdamālipya tathā majje ""dṛtaṃ japet‌ | puṃsūktenābhiṣicya svamācāmejjalatīrayoḥ || 34 || sa ācāme'ntaraṅgānāṃ snānarūpo nigadyate | ṛgyajuḥsāmavedaistu caturthyantaiḥ svaradvayaiḥ || 35 || aś‍īta trirmukhaṃ tiryaṅ‌mārjayed‌d‌viḥ spṛśannapaḥ| ""atharvavedāya nama iti prācyo manustayoḥ || 36 || ""itihāsapurāṇābhyāṃ nama ityaparomataḥ | ""agnaye nama ityuk‍vā mārjayedadha ānanam‌ || 37 || ""viṣṇave namaityuk‍vā siñcetprapadayorjalam‌ | sāṅguṣṭhayā'nāmikayā spṛśeccakṣurdvayaṃ kramāt‌ || 38 || sa vāmāṃse tu tarjanyā śrotre'ṅgutnyā kaniṣṭhayā | samastābhirvāmapāṇiṃ sīmāṃ madhyamayā spṛśet‌ || 39 || hṛdayaṃ ca samastābhiḥ sūryo vāyurdiśastathā | vasiṣṭhaḥ śrīḥ parātmā ca soddeśā hṛdvasānakāḥ || 40 || tatra mantrāḥ praśasyante mantrācāmo'yamīritaḥ | viṣṇupādodakasnāyī śucinā''veṣṭ‌ya vāsasā || 41 || vimucyā'rdraṃ kṣālitāyāṃ kaṭ‌yāmud‌grathayecca tat‌ | ācamya punarācamya gopyā puṇḍāṇi dhārayet‌ || 42 || salilairvā'pyasau kuryāllalāṭodarahṛdgale | dakṣiṇe pārśvadormūlakaṇṭhapārśveṣu savyataḥ || 43 || pṛṣṭhamūle ca kakudi mūrdhanyādyantayorapi | tanmanurdvādaśārṇaḥ syādapare keśavādayaḥ || 44 || sudarśanaṃ ca śa'ṃ ca mudrayedvāhumūlayoḥ | sa śuciḥ snāta ācānto bahirantaḥ smaran‌ harim‌ || 45 || trirapāmañjaliṃ datvā sāvitrīṃ śaktito japet‌ | vandetātha parātmādīndoḥsaṃdhyādipuraḥsaram‌ || 46 || prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā varṇanyāsaṃ samācaret‌ | ""doḥpatsandhiṣu sāgreṣu nābhihṛnmukhakeṣviti || 47 || vyāpakaṃ nyasya tārādīnyaṅgānyṛṣyādikānnyaset‌ | sūryamaṇḍalagaṃ viṣṇuṃ dhyāyan‌ madhvoktavartmanā || 48 || gāyatrīṃ prajapenmaunī prīyatāṃ bhagavāniti | same rahaḥ śucau deśe padmadyanyatamāsanaḥ || 49 || siñcayedvā puro brahma prāṅ‌mukhaḥ prāñjaliḥ smaran‌ | madhye savyetare savye gurūnsarvāśca devatāḥ || 50 || nametsarvagurūnmūle satāroddeśahṛtsvakaiḥ | budhastaiḥ samanujñātaḥ karanyāsaṃ samācaret‌ || 51 || bāhvorantarbahiḥ pārśve kaniṣṭhādyaṅgulīṣu ca | nyasettārāgnibījena karanyāso'yamīritaḥ || 52 || nṛsiṃhāgnirjvalatpāṇistena tālatrayaṃ kriyāt‌ | tannirgatairviṣphuliṅgaprakarairvighnato dahet‌ || 53 || sphuṭāstramudrayā vāyupreritajvaladarciṣā | drāvayeddahyamānāṃstānkramādbadhnan‌ diśo daśa || 54 || prākāraṃ parito'gneḥ svaṃ kalpayedekamudrayā | ṛjukāyopaviṣṭasya suṣumnā'sya prakāśate || 55 || mūrdhanyoparigādityasuṣumnāghṛṇidīpikā | tanmadhye hadaye padme mūlasuṣṭ‌yādikāraṇam‌ || 56 || smarennārāyaṇaṃ tasya pratibimbaṃ jñānabalaudāryabhaktayānandādiṣu sthitān‌ || 27 || gatansasaptāvaraṇabrahmāṇḍavayaveṣvapi | lokeṣvapi ca sarveṣu samāgaramahītale || 28 || samudrasaptake saptadvīpeṣu ca pṛthak‌ pṛthak‌ | navakhaṇḍeṣu mervādiparvatādiṣu ca sthitān‌ || 29 || tadaṇḍeṣvapi sarveṣu sarvato vyāpya saṃsthitān‌ | viṣṇoraṃśaṃstathājñānabalānandādikānapi || 30 || jñātvā tānrāmakṛṣṇādirūpasyāṃśān‌ paranpṛthak‌ | rāmarāmo rāmakṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇarāma iti kramāt‌ || 31 || śaktīḥ sarvā hareraṃśā ekasya ca harestathā | rūpāṇi cintayetpaścājjñānānandabalādikān‌ || 32 || rāmakṛṣṇādirūpeṇa saṃsthitāṃśca pṛthak‌ pṛthak‌ | jñānarāmo jñānakṛṣṇaḥ jñānavyāsa iti kramāt‌ || 33 || saṃsthitānguṇaguṇyādikriyāvayavarūpakān‌ | dhyātvā viṣṇauḥ parānaṃśānśvetadvīpādiṣu sthitān‌ || 34 || muktāmukteṣu jīveṣu tatveṣu ca viśeṣataḥ | tanniyāmakadeveṣu tadguṇādiṣu ca sthitān‌ || 35 || śrīraṅgādiṣu sarvatra sāligrāmādikeṣvapi | śrīmadānandatīrthāryakarakañjārcitāsu ca || 36 || kṛṣṇarāmavyāsapūrvapratimāsvapi sarvaśaḥ | jñātvaiṣāṃ paramaik‍ṃ ca pūrṇasvātantryayogataḥ || 37 || nissīmaśaktimattvācca tattatsthānasthitānapi | avihāya sthitiṃ tatra svārcābimbagatānsadā || 38 || pūrṇatvāddehakālādivyavadhānojjhitānsadā | sampūjya mānase pūrvaṃ svarataṃ taṃ ramāpatim‌ || 39 || gandhapuṣpādibhissamyagarcābimbe viśeṣataḥ | pūrvokteṣu ca sarveṣu pratimāvayaveṣu ca || 40 || tadgateṣu ca sarveṣu pratimārūpakeṣvapi | cintāyitvā sannidhānaṃ prārthayetparamātmanaḥ || 41 || pūjopayuktadravyeṣu gandhapuṣpādikeṣu ca | tathopahārarūpeṣu bhakṣyabhojyādikeṣvapi || 42 || cāmaravyajane chatragītavādyādikeṣvapi | sthitaḥ svarūpabhoktā'sau pūjyabimbasthito hariḥ || 43 || kṛtvā'rcādisaparyāśca pujāṃ kuryādvidhānataḥ | harirbimbasthitaḥ svātmabhoktā bhogyasthito vibhuḥ || 44 || pūjopahārarūpeṣu gandhapuṣpādivastuṣu | sthito viṣṇuḥ pūjyabimbagataṃ svātmānameva hi || 45 || gandhapuṣpādirūpeṇa svīkuryātparameśvaraḥ | pūjakāntargato viṣṇuḥ pūjyabimbagato hariḥ || 46 || pūjyapūjakarūpeṇa bhoktṛbhojyātmanā tathā | ramate hariraivaikaḥ krīāḍayā parameśvaraḥ || 47 || evaṃ sañcintya manasā sarvatra jagadīśvaram‌ | pūjayejjagatāmīśaṃ yathāvibhavamarcakaḥ || 48 || dayālutvaṃ pareśasya varṇayetkaḥ pumānbhuvi | dravyasampādanāyāsaḥ pūjārthaṃ naiva vidyate || 49 || niṣkiñcanairapi hariḥ pūjyate hi dhanaṃ vinā | svarūpalābhapūrṇasya bhaktireva prayojikā || 50 || vāsanārūpake bimbe bhakticintāprakalpite | anekaratnakhacitadivyabhūṣaṇasaṃyute || 51 || sthito viṣṇurbhaktapūjāṃ svīkaroti ramāpatiḥ | vāsanārūpakonbhojyānbhuṅ‌k‍e tatpravicintitān‌ || 52 || gandhamālyāmbarādīṃśca bhakṣyabhojyādikānapi | bhuṅ‌k‍e viṣṇuḥ pūrṇaśaktiḥ bāhyabhogavilakṣaṇān‌ || 53 || pānīyādīnbahuvidhānsvarṇapātreṣu saṃsthitān‌ | vāsanārūpakeṣvaddhā padārtheṣu pṛthak‌ pṛthak‌ || 54 || tattadākārasaṃyuktansvarūpānsvīkarotyajaḥ | iti vijñānamātreṇa pūjito bhavati sphuṭam‌ || 55 || tattadākārasaṃyuktā devāḥ sarve'pi sarvadā | sthitā bhojyapadārtheṣu hyarpayeyuḥ svarūpakān‌ || 56 || mahālakṣmīsvarūpāṇi bhojyavastusthitāni ca | tattadākārayuktāni rasagandhātmakāni ca || 57 || pūrṇabhogyasvarūpātmā punarbhogānkarotyajaḥ | brahmādisarvajīvānaṃ svarūpaṃ svīkarotyasau || 58 | svarūpānandabhoktā ca teṣāṃ viṣṇussanātanaḥ | ajādisarvamuktānāṃ vicitrānandasantitam‌ || 59 || muktabhogyānacintyāṃśca bhuṅ‌k‍e devo'mitadyutiḥ | susvādu mahadāścaryaṃ lokato'tivilakṣaṇam‌ || 60 || mahālakṣmīsvarūpaṃ ca bhogyajātaṃ mahādbhutam‌ | svasvarūpātmakaṃ divyaṃ manovācāmagocaram‌ || 61 || anantendriyasambhogyaṃ bhuṅ‌k‍e hyānandasāgaraḥ | iti vijñānamātreṇa prīto bhavati nityaśaḥ || 62 || pūjakāntargato viṣṇuḥ svarūpaṃ svayameva hi | līlayā'rcayati śrīśaḥ tadadhiṣṭhānamātrataḥ || 63 || bhaktānāṃ phalado viṣṇurbhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | cetanāntargato viṣṇuricchājñānaprayatnakān‌ || 64 || utpādya cetaneṣvīśaḥ dattvā svādhīnakartutām‌ | svabhaktaṃ phalabhājaṃ hi karoti jagadīśvaraḥ || 65 || vanasthānphalamūlādīn‌ vinā dravyaṃ sukhāgatān‌ | īṣatprayatnatassādhyānyo nityaṃ hyarpayedbudhaḥ || 66 || tasya prīto jagannātho bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | bhaktānukampī viṣṇurhi kimu vaktavyameva hi || 67 || patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yo me bhaktayā prayacchati | tadahaṃ bhaktayupahṛtamaś‍āmi prayatātmanaḥ || 68 || iti viṣṇorhi vacanaṃ kṛpā viṣṇoḥ parātmanaḥ | bhakteṣu vartate nityamiti jñeyaṃ bubhūṣubhiḥ || 69 || śarīrayātrāsid‌dhyarthamannapānadhanādikān‌ | sampādayati yāneva pūjārthaṃ tānprakalpayet‌ || 70 || phalapuṣpādikeṣvīśaḥ jaḍeṣvapi hariḥ paraḥ | svamātrabhogyasārāṃśca mahālak‍pyāstathaiva ca || 71 || brahmeśaśakrakāmādidevānāṃ ca pṛthak‌ pṛthak‌ | evaṃ mānuṣaparyantaṃ sthitānāmadhikāriṇām‌ || 72 || yogyānsārāṃstathā śrīśaḥ pūrṇānandaḥ parātparaḥ | bhuṅ‌k‍e devaḥ parānando hyacintyaiśvaryayogataḥ || 73 || mānuṣendriyabhogyāṃstu svadṛṣṭ‌vā svīkarotyajaḥ | iti jñātvā rameśasya hyarpaṇādeva sarvadā || 74 || prīto bhavetparānandavigrahaḥ parameśvaraḥ | mahākāruṇiko viṣṇuḥ yasmādbhūtabhaviṣyagān‌ || 75 || karmasaṅghāndevasaṅghāndārāpatyadhanādikān‌ | sakṛtsamarpaṇādeva hyanantaphalado bhavet‌ || 76 || vidhivāk‍ānusāreṇa kṛtaṃ viṣṇau samarpayet‌ | tathā niṣedhatastyaktān‌ sarvāṃstasmai samarpayet‌ || 77 || tasmādīśvarapūjārthaṃ na dravyārjanavānbhavet‌ | tasmānmahākārūṇiko harireva na cāparaḥ || 78 || triṣu dhāmasu yadbhojyaṃ bhoktā yastu prakīrtitaḥ | vedaitadubhayaṃ yastu sa bhuñjāno na lipyate || 79 || anyādṛśī bhavedbhuktiracintyā daivatairapi | ityādi ca yathāśaktiṃ saṃsmareddharimojane || 80 || mānuṣā varṇabhedena tathaivā'śramabhedataḥ | kṣitipā manuṣyagandharvāḥ devāśca pitaraścirāḥ || 81 || ājānajāḥ karmajāśca jayādyāḥ sanakādayaḥ | puṣkaraḥ śiṣṭadevāśca śaniścoṣā budhastathā || 82 || svāhā tathaiva parjanyo manavo vāyujastathā | vighneśvaraśca mitraśca vasiṣṭho'gniśca nāradaḥ || 83 || varuṇo vidhuśca pravahaḥ aniruddhaśca taijasaḥ | indrome mitravindā ca rudro vāṇī ca mārutaḥ || 84 || uttarottaratastvete bhagavadbhaktigocarāḥ | teṣu bhaktiḥ krameṇaiva kāryā nityaṃ mumukṣubhiḥ || 85 || sarve'pi guravaścaite puruṣasya sadaiva hi | tasmātpūjyāśca namyāśca dhyeyāśca parito harim‌ || 86 || umādimārutānteṣu samaḥ samaguṇo'pi san‌ | dhyātaḥ prītiṃ hariryāyādadhikā uttarottare || 87 || nāmādimārutānteṣu deveṣvebhyaśca bhedataḥ | upāsito harirmuktiṃ dadyānnāstyatra saṃśayaḥ || 88 || iti yogadīpikāyāṃ daśamaḥ paṭalaḥ iti
